'''2000 Ottawa Grand Slam Yannick Lapointe Why Hothice plains player are Hot''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2nd at [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]]. The post (26 May 2000) says: "this deck is still in play testing, i play with it at Ottawa GS and finished second."<ref name="dt-7160">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7160 Why Hothice plains player are Hot], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 26 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7160/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7160/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018164226/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7160/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Why Hothice plains player are Hot'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' May 26, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' this deck is unexpected and when your opponent realize what happening the game over

=== Strategy ===

this deck is still in play testing, i play with it at Ottawa GS and finished second. people dont expect revo in HB so choke him beat what he deploy get the card you need with tunnel vision and tibrin then retrieve with OMDH get it back with tibrin and retrieve until you have no card in lost this deck is pretty solid but like i said it is still in playtesting if your wondering why no alter...its because i dont need it most of the card i fear are interrupt so sense is more usefull. grab alter and play sense i would like to put 2 more sense in it but the deck is tight. against most of the deck start Goonee tay to slow him if he dont start Crush revolve even if you dont have a grabbler and if he start crush( after scouting) wait until you have one
